description: T-4554: T-4394's book (First, S2, Last; B1 = 1, 7, 9; B2 = 10, 70, 90) with S2 active. Workbook names added through the API (Graph names/add) whose body is a bare name: WL = =LocLoc, where LocLoc is only S2's sheet-scoped name (S2!$B$1, 7); WD = =Dup, where Dup is both a workbook name (First!$B$2, 10) and S2's and Last's sheet-scoped names (S2!$B$2, 70; Last!$B$2, 90); and LD = =Dup scoped to Last. Does the body bind to the active sheet's scoped name, to the workbook name, or to the using sheet's?
